== Notes ==
* As a result of this hex, target foe's raw [[damage]] output is expected to decrease by 33%.
* Similarly to blocking, hexes that cause misses combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and [[Price of Failure]] has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
* Good synergy with skills like [[Spiteful Spirit]] and [[Empathy]] in [[Normal mode]]; the increased attack speed will trigger these more often. 
* This skill will not increase [[mob]]s' attack speed in [[Hard mode]] because they are already at the attack speed cap; however, it will still cause them to miss.

== Trivia ==
